part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getrangeCommand` (src/t_string.c:4479), used by both SUBSTR and GETRANGE: the early `start < 0 && end < 0 && start > end` check compared raw values, missing cases like `start=0, end=-500` where the converted `end` only becomes less than `start` afterward and got clamped to 0, wrongly returning the first character.

The fix (src/t_string.c:4500-4508) converts negative indexes first, then returns an empty reply if `end` is still negative (i.e. points before the string start); the existing `start > end` check handles the rest. Verified with the issue repro (all `end < start` variants now return `""`) and the full `unit/type/string` test suite passes.
